claude.performance_metric: cash acquisition at $10.30/share (~$4.55bn) then deregistered; no in-window trajectory
claude.rationale: The registrant was acquired for cash (~$4.55bn) by GLP-funded Western Logistics entities on Nov 4, 2015 and deregistered its common stock (Form 15-12G), so no independent audited public 3-5-year (~2017-2019) trajectory exists for the acquired operating business. The only later same-CIK filings belong to a distinct residual successor (DC Industrial Liquidating Trust holding 11 residual properties), not the ~296-building operating portfolio the acquirer absorbed. With no documented post-deal operating trajectory, there is no realized-outcome evidence of product/process disruption (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5), so both are coded uncertain.

gemini.rationale: The company was acquired for cash and deregistered in 2015, with no independent public trajectory available for the acquired business in the 2017-2019 window. Consequently, there is no documented evidence regarding post-deal product/process alignment or process/organization integration.

grok.performance_metric: cash-acquired ~$4.55bn at $10.30/sh; deregistered; no public 3-5yr operating record
grok.rationale: The slice documents that after the Nov 2015 cash merger the registrant deregistered and no audited public annual report of the acquired operating portfolio exists for the ~2017-2019 window, with later same-CIK filings belonging only to a distinct residual liquidating trust holding 11 properties. Consequently no realized product/process interface disruption (p4) and no realized process/organization fracture (p5) are documented at the 3-5 year horizon; absence of such evidence codes to 0 for both pathways.
